ai.purpose: WealthFlow AI Intelligence Platform workspace for business data reasoning, architecture inquiries, prompt library management, and cross-application assistance. Instant answers also cover your budgets (limit, spent, left, over the limit) and recurring payments (upcoming, total per month).
steps: Select a question domain (Business Data or App Architecture).
Open the Prompt Library to choose, search, filter, or insert reusable prompts into the chat input.
Create, edit, favorite, and manage custom AI prompts organized by categories.
Ask a natural language query about your financial metrics or codebase.

Ask how-to questions such as where to record a purchase: the assistant answers from the app's own documentation and how data flows, without reading your numbers. If the AI model is too slow to answer, you get the documented facts themselves, labelled as retrieval-only.
Rate an answer with the thumbs up or down under it; approved how-to answers are reused for similar questions and rejected ones never are.
Manage conversations and switch between multi-thread chats.

ai::prompt_library.purpose: Centralized repository for browsing, searching, filtering, and inserting reusable prompts into the AI Workspace chat input.
steps: Open the Prompt Library from the AI Workspace sidebar card or input toolbar button.
Search prompts by name, description, or content, or filter by category and favorites.
Preview full prompt template content with formatting preserved.
Click 'Insert Prompt' to populate the chat input field without auto-submitting.
Favorite, duplicate, edit, or delete existing prompts.

ai::create_prompt.purpose: Create or edit custom reusable prompts with name, category, description, and template content.
steps: Click 'New Prompt' inside the Prompt Library modal.
Enter a unique prompt name and select an active category.
Provide an optional short description and the exact prompt template content.
Mark as favorite if desired, then save the prompt.

ai::pinned_chats.purpose: Quick access panel listing all conversations the user has pinned for fast retrieval, separate from the full chronological chat history.
steps: Open Pinned Chats from the AI Workspace sidebar card.
Click a pinned conversation to jump directly into it.
Unpin a conversation to remove it from this list.

ai::learned_answers.purpose: Review the answers you rated with the thumbs up or down, see which approved how-to answers the AI reuses for similar questions, and clear a rating.
steps: Open Learned Answers from the AI Workspace sidebar card.
Read each rated question and answer; a green badge means the answer is reused for similar questions, a grey badge means it is not.
Click the clear button on a row to remove your rating; a cleared answer is no longer reused.

ai::knowledge_search.purpose: Search across all Knowledge Base entries and inject relevant results directly into the active AI chat conversation.
steps: Open Knowledge Search from the AI Workspace sidebar card.
Type a search term to filter Knowledge Base entries in real time.
Expand an entry to review its full content.
Inject, copy, edit, or delete an entry directly from the results list.

ai::knowledge_base.purpose: Central repository of curated business, financial, and application knowledge entries that the AI engine references when answering questions.
steps: Open Knowledge Base from the AI Workspace context panel.
Filter entries by category using the tab bar.
Trigger a scan to detect new candidate knowledge from recent activity.
Select an entry to review its full content, or add a new one.

ai::add_knowledge_entry.purpose: Add a new Knowledge Base entry with category, title, and content that the AI engine can draw on for future responses.
steps: Open Knowledge Base and click 'New Entry'.
Select a category and provide a title.
Enter the knowledge content.
Save the entry to make it available to the AI engine.

ai::dataset_manager.purpose: Review generated training/fine-tuning dataset statistics and trigger generation of new datasets from application activity.
steps: Open Dataset Manager from the AI Workspace context panel.
Review current dataset statistics broken down by category.
Refresh statistics or generate a new dataset.

ai::model_management.purpose: Review available AI model backends and versions, promote a version to active, or trigger fine-tuning.
steps: Open Model Management from the AI Workspace context panel.
Review the list of model versions and their status.
Promote a version to active, or trigger a new fine-tuning run.

ai::benchmark_results.purpose: Review AI model quality benchmark reports scored across multiple evaluation dimensions.
steps: Open Benchmark Results from the AI Workspace context panel.
Review existing benchmark reports and their scores.
Run a new benchmark evaluation.

settings::settings-aiadvisor.purpose: Configure Self-Evolving AI Platform settings, SFT dataset matrix, training backends, and fine-tuning controls.
steps: Review SFT dataset metrics.
Select training backend.
Trigger model fine-tuning or autonomous learning scan.
Turn Instant Data Answers on or off: when on, simple data questions (balances, salary, expenses, gold price, exchange rates) are answered instantly from your own data without the AI model.

Set the default monthly AI token limit and optional per-user overrides in the 'Monthly AI token limit per user' frame, above the platform and model-history section: a blank override uses the default and 0 means unlimited. Search users by name or email, filter by AI settings mode, use Toggle Select All (or tick users) and Apply to selected to set one limit for many users at once. Limits apply only to users on the general app settings; users on their own AI settings are never limited. Long tables show 5 rows with a Show all / Show less toggle.

settings::settings-legal.purpose: System administrators edit the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service text shown on the public /privacy/ and /terms/ pages, per language, and keep a version history.
steps: Pick a language and a document (Terms of Service or Privacy Policy), then edit the page title and each section title and text; add or remove sections, or reset the document to the built-in text.
Type a new version label and press Publish new version. Languages you did not edit keep the built-in text, and accounts keep the version they accepted at signup.
Tick Require every user to accept this version again to show every user a one-time acceptance dialog after login.
Use Load into editor on a row of the version history to start a new version from an older one.

settings::settings-myai.purpose: Choose whether your AI Advisor uses the general app settings or your own provider, model, API key and generation options.
steps: Leave 'Use general app settings' on to use the shared configuration; your monthly token usage and limit are shown at the top.
Turn it off to enter your own provider, model, API key and options; your own settings have no monthly token limit.
Save. Switching back to the general settings keeps your own values for later but ignores them.

Add any other currency you hold. EGP stays available if you still hold EGP data.

settings::settings-backuprestore.purpose: Create, download, upload and restore portable backups (.wfbackup). A backup contains every table of application data: financial records, budgets and recurring transactions, settings, users, roles, permissions and group links, login-attempt records, the admin change history and AI data. Only temporary login sessions are left out.
steps: Create & Download Backup to save a portable .wfbackup file.
Create Server Backup to keep a copy on the server and see it in the Server Backups list.
Upload & Restore Backup to restore from a file; permissions and group links are matched by name, so they restore correctly on another server.

settings::settings-documentation.purpose: Configure the administrative settings and preferences for Settings Documentation.
steps: Navigate to the Settings panel.

auth::create_account.purpose: Register a new WealthFlow account to begin tracking your wealth. You must accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account.
steps: Fill in your personal details.
Create a secure password.
Tick the box to accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (both open in a new tab).
Submit the form to create your account, then confirm your email.

auth::forgot_password.purpose: Recover access to your account if you forgot your password.
steps: Enter your registered email address.
Check your inbox for a reset link.
Follow the link to create a new password.

auth::login.purpose: Authenticate into your WealthFlow account securely.
steps: Enter your email address.
Enter your secure password.
Click Login to access your dashboard.

dashboard.purpose: Provides a comprehensive, real-time overview of your net worth, recent transactions, and financial health.
steps: Log in to WealthFlow.
Review the top-level KPI widgets for Net Worth and Cash Flow.
Analyze the charts to understand your financial trends.

dashboard::user_profile.purpose: Manage your personal profile, avatar, and individual user settings.
steps: Click on your avatar in the top right corner.
Update your personal details or upload a new profile picture.
Save your changes.

financial-advisor::overview.purpose: Get AI-driven insights summarizing your entire financial standing and immediate action items.
steps: Navigate to the Financial Advisor Overview tab.
Read the AI-generated summary of your wealth.
Review the top recommendations for immediate action.

financial-advisor::cash-flow.purpose: Analyze your historical and current cash flow metrics, comparing income against expenses.
steps: Select the Cash Flow tab.
Adjust the time period filter.
Analyze income versus expense breakdowns.

financial-advisor::wealth-growth.purpose: Track the historical growth of your net worth and investment portfolio over time.
steps: Select the Wealth Growth tab.
Review your net worth trajectory.
Identify periods of high growth or decline.

financial-advisor::portfolio.purpose: Review your asset allocation and portfolio diversification across different asset classes.
steps: Navigate to the Portfolio tab.
Review the pie chart showing asset distribution.
Identify any over-concentrated asset classes.

financial-advisor::goal-planning.purpose: Set, track, and manage your long-term financial goals and milestones.
steps: Navigate to Goal Planning.
Create a new financial goal.
Track your progress towards the target amount.

financial-advisor::risk-analysis.purpose: Evaluate your exposure to market risks, currency fluctuations, and liquidity constraints.
steps: Open the Risk Analysis tab.
Review the AI risk score.
Read the mitigation strategies provided by the advisor.

financial-advisor::spending-intelligence.purpose: Gain deep insights into your spending habits, identifying unnecessary subscriptions or high-expense categories.
steps: Navigate to Spending Intelligence.
Review the breakdown of discretionary vs mandatory spending.
Identify areas to cut costs.

financial-advisor::opportunity-detection.purpose: Discover personalized investment opportunities and strategies to optimize your idle cash.
steps: Open Opportunity Detection.
Review the systems suggestions for high-yield savings or asset purchases.
Assess the projected ROI for each opportunity.

financial-advisor::performance.purpose: Analyze historical gold prices, exchange rate trends, and your total gold exposure impact in your default currency over time.
steps: Navigate to Performance.
Review 24K gold historical prices, moving averages, and exposure impacts.
Analyze exchange rate trends and moving averages across USD, EUR, and SAR.

financial-advisor::what-if-simulator.purpose: Simulate various financial scenarios to see their impact on your net worth.
steps: Navigate to the What-If Simulator.
Adjust the sliders to model different economic or personal scenarios.
Review the projected impact on your long-term wealth.

financial-advisor::scenario-planner.purpose: Simulate multi-event life scenarios and compare trajectories against your real baseline.
steps: Navigate to the Scenario Planner.
Configure life events like buying a house, salary changes, marriage, or starting a business.
Review the side-by-side N-scenario comparison and rule-based insights.

Review base salary, allowances, and deductions.

salary-1.purpose: Manage your income streams, salary structures, and employment benefits.

salary-7::add_salary_entry.purpose: Record a new monthly salary payout or income entry.
steps: Click Add Entry.
Enter the exact payout amount and date.
Save the entry to update your cash flow.

salary-7::add_perdiem1.purpose: Manage your per diem allowances and daily travel compensations.
steps: Open the Per Diem modal.
Enter your travel dates and daily rates.
Save the allowance to your income sheet.

salary-7::add_perdiem2.purpose: Manage your per diem allowances and daily travel compensations.
steps: Open the Per Diem modal.
Enter your travel dates and daily rates.
Save the allowance to your income sheet.

all-companies.purpose: Manage the list of employers, businesses, or organizations associated with your income streams.
steps: Navigate to All Companies.
Review the list of active companies.
Click on a company to edit its details.

all-companies::add_company.purpose: Register a new company or employer to the system.
steps: Click Add Company.
Enter the company name, industry, and contact details.
Save the company profile.

balance::overview.purpose: View a consolidated summary of all your bank accounts, liquid cash, and total balances.
steps: Navigate to Balance > Overview.
Review the total liquid wealth.
Analyze the distribution of funds across different banks.

balance::accounts.purpose: Manage individual bank accounts, view their balances, and track their transaction histories.
steps: Navigate to the Accounts tab.
Select a specific bank account.
Review its current balance and recent activity.

balance::accounts::add_balance.purpose: Manually adjust or record a new balance entry for a specific bank account.
steps: Click Add Balance.
Select the account and enter the new balance amount.
Save to update your records.

balance::transfers.purpose: Track and manage internal fund transfers between your own bank accounts.
steps: Navigate to the Transfers tab.
Review the history of internal movements.
Verify the status of pending transfers.

balance::transfers::add_transfer.purpose: Record a new internal transfer of funds from one account to another.
steps: Click Add Transfer.
Select the source account and destination account.
Enter the amount and date, then save.

balance::transfers::edit_transfer.purpose: Modify or update an existing internal transfer transaction.
steps: Click the Edit icon next to a transfer entry in the table.
Adjust transfer amounts, dates, or accounts as required.
Click Save to update the transfer and re-balance accounts.

balance::currency_exchange.purpose: Record and manage currency exchanges between balances in different currencies.
steps: Navigate to the Currency Exchange tab under Balance.
Review past currency exchange transactions and rates.
Click New Exchange to perform a new currency conversion.

balance::currency_exchange::new_exchange.purpose: Perform a new currency exchange between source and destination balance entries.
steps: Click New Exchange.
Select source balance and destination balance.
Enter the exchange amount and verify exchange rate and received amount.
Click Save Exchange to post the transaction.

balance::currency_exchange::edit_exchang.purpose: Modify or update an existing active currency exchange transaction.
steps: Click the Edit icon next to an active exchange in the table.
Adjust exchange rates or amounts as required.
Click Save Exchange to apply atomic balance recalculation.

balance::allocation.purpose: Analyze how your liquid cash is allocated across different currencies or regions.
steps: Navigate to the Allocation tab.
Review the currency breakdown charts.
Ensure your cash is sufficiently diversified.

balance::forecasts.purpose: Project your future bank balances based on expected income and recurring expenses.
steps: Navigate to the Forecasts tab.
Review the projected cash flow graph.
Identify any potential future liquidity shortages.

balance::recommendations.purpose: Receive AI suggestions on optimizing your cash holdings, such as moving idle funds to high-yield accounts.
steps: Navigate to Recommendations.
Review the AI suggestions for cash optimization.
Execute the recommended transfers if desired.

bank-certificates.purpose: Track and manage your fixed-term bank deposit certificates and bonds.
steps: Navigate to Bank Certificates.
Review your active and matured certificates.
Track the accrued interest and maturity dates.

bank-certificates::add_certificate.purpose: Register a new fixed-term bank certificate into your portfolio.
steps: Click Add Certificate.
Enter the principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date.
Save the certificate details.

bank-certificates::interest_history.purpose: View the historical interest payouts received from a specific certificate.
steps: Click on Interest History for a certificate.
Review the schedule of payouts.
Verify that the amounts match your bank statements.

fixed-assets::assets.purpose: Manage the detailed profiles of your individual fixed assets (Real Estate, Gold, Vehicles, etc.).
steps: Navigate to the Assets tab.
Browse your list of assets.
Click on an asset to view or edit its detailed profile.

fixed-assets::assets::general.purpose: View or edit the primary general information (name, type, purchase date) of the asset.
steps: Navigate to the General sub-tab.
Update the assets core details.
Save your changes.

fixed-assets::assets::asset-core.purpose: Manage specific characteristics of a gold asset, such as purity (karat), weight, and maker.
steps: Navigate to the Gold Details sub-tab.
Enter the exact weight in grams and karat purity.
Save the details to ensure accurate live valuation.

fixed-assets::assets::photos.purpose: Upload and manage visual evidence and photos of the physical asset.
steps: Navigate to the Photos sub-tab.
Click Upload to add new images.
Set a primary cover image for the asset.

fixed-assets::assets::sale.purpose: Record the sale or disposal of the asset, calculating the final realized profit or loss.
steps: Navigate to the Sale sub-tab.
Enter the sale date and final sale price.
Confirm the disposal to remove it from active valuation.

fixed-assets::assets::gold_details.purpose: Manage specific characteristics of a gold asset, such as purity (karat), weight, and maker.
steps: Navigate to the Gold Details sub-tab.
Enter the exact weight in grams and karat purity.
Save the details to ensure accurate live valuation.

fixed-assets::assets::documents_title.purpose: Store and manage legal documents, title deeds, and purchase receipts for the asset.
steps: Navigate to the Documents sub-tab.
Upload PDF or image copies of legal deeds.
Securely save the records.

fixed-assets::assets::property.purpose: Manage real-estate specific details such as property type, address, area size, and zoning.
steps: Navigate to the Property sub-tab.
Enter the square footage and physical address.
Save the property specifics.

fixed-assets::assets::renovations.purpose: Track the costs of any renovations or improvements made to the property, which add to its cost basis.
steps: Navigate to the Renovations sub-tab.
Add a new renovation entry with its cost and date.
Save to update the assets total capital invested.

fixed-assets::assets::acquisition_costs.purpose: Record the supplementary costs of acquiring the asset, such as broker fees, taxes, and legal fees.
steps: Navigate to the Acquisition Costs sub-tab.
Enter any fees incurred during purchase.
Save to accurately calculate your true cost basis.

fixed-assets::assets::furniture.purpose: Inventory the furniture and appliances included within a real estate property.
steps: Navigate to the Furniture sub-tab.
List the items and their estimated values.
Save the inventory.

fixed-assets::assets::mortgage.purpose: Track the financing and mortgage details attached to this specific property.
steps: Navigate to the Mortgage sub-tab.
Enter the loan amount, interest rate, and term.
Track your remaining principal balance.

fixed-assets::assets::rental.purpose: Manage the rental income, tenant details, and lease agreements for an investment property.
steps: Navigate to the Rental sub-tab.
Enter the active lease details and monthly rent.
Track the generated yield.

fixed-assets::assets::valuation_history.purpose: Track the historical market appraisals and manual valuations of the asset over time.
steps: Navigate to Valuation History.
Add a new manual valuation entry based on current market rates.
Save to update your current net worth.

fixed-assets::assets::vehicle.purpose: Manage the detailed profiles of your individual fixed assets (Real Estate, Gold, Vehicles, etc.).
steps: Navigate to the Assets tab.
Browse your list of assets.
Click on an asset to view or edit its detailed profile.

fixed-assets::assets::maintenance.purpose: Manage the detailed profiles of your individual fixed assets (Real Estate, Gold, Vehicles, etc.).

fixed-assets::assets::insurance.purpose: Manage the detailed profiles of your individual fixed assets (Real Estate, Gold, Vehicles, etc.).

fixed-assets::assets::details.purpose: Manage the detailed profiles of your individual fixed assets (Real Estate, Gold, Vehicles, etc.).

Click on an asset to view or edit its detailed profile.

fixed-assets::dashboard.purpose: View a high-level summary of all your illiquid fixed assets, including real estate and gold.
steps: Navigate to Fixed Assets > Dashboard.
Review the total valuation of your physical assets.
Analyze the breakdown by asset class.

fixed-assets::reports.purpose: Generate comprehensive PDF or Excel reports detailing your fixed asset portfolio.
steps: Navigate to the Reports tab.
Select the desired reporting period and asset classes.
Click Generate to download the report.

exchange-rates.purpose: Monitor live global currency exchange rates and track historical forex trends.
steps: Navigate to Exchange Rates.
Review the live currency pairs.
Use the charts to analyze historical exchange rate movements.

gold-price.purpose: Monitor gold prices per gram. Users in Egypt see the Egyptian dealer price in EGP with buy and sell prices; users whose base currency is a Gulf currency (SAR, AED) see the international spot price converted to their own currency.
steps: Navigate to Gold Price.
Review the price per gram for each carat in your currency and the USD exchange rate used.
Select Refresh Prices to fetch the latest prices.
Remember that shop prices include making charges and are higher than the spot price.

expenses.purpose: Track your day-to-day spending and manage your personal or business expenses.
steps: Navigate to Expenses.
Review your recent expense entries.
Analyze your spending via the summary charts.

expenses::edit_add_expenses.purpose: Record a new expense or modify an existing transaction.
steps: Click Add Expense.
Enter the amount, date, payee, and select a category.
Save the transaction.

expense-categories.purpose: Manage the taxonomy of your spending by creating and organizing expense categories.
steps: Navigate to Expense Categories.
Review your active list of categories.
Reorganize or edit categories as needed.

expense-categories::add_category.purpose: Create a new top-level expense category.

Provide a name and select an icon/color.
Save the new category.

expense-categories::add_subcategory.purpose: Create a nested subcategory for more granular expense tracking.
steps: Click Add Subcategory under a parent.
Provide a name and assign it to the parent category.
Save the subcategory.

reports::monthly.purpose: View monthly income, expense breakdowns, and monthly financial performance summaries.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Reports.
Select the Monthly tab.
Choose the desired month and year to view category-wise spending and income comparisons.

reports::yearly.purpose: Analyze annual financial trends, year-over-year expense growth, and cumulative annual savings.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Reports.
Select the Yearly tab.
Select the evaluation year to review annual charts and overall financial health metrics.

reports::custom.purpose: Generate custom date-range financial reports for specific auditing or planning periods.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Reports.
Select the Custom Range tab.
Pick the start and end dates, then view the filtered transactions and balance summaries.

advanced-reports::salary.purpose: Analyze comprehensive salary earnings, allowances, deductions, and per diem payouts across time.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Advanced Reports.
Select the Salary tab.
Review compensation trends, net payout distributions, and company-wise salary totals.

advanced-reports::balance.purpose: Review total asset liquidity, bank vs cash ratios, certificate growth, and net balance trajectory.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Advanced Reports.
Select the Balance tab.
Examine historical net worth charts, asset allocation balances, and account performance.

advanced-reports::certificates.purpose: Track bank certificate maturity schedules, expected interest yields, and active vs redeemed certificate statuses.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Advanced Reports.
Select the Certificates tab.
Review yield distribution charts, bank certificate portfolios, and upcoming payout dates.

Adjust the system preferences as needed.
Save the configuration to apply changes globally.

settings::settings-goldsettings::add_gol.purpose: Configure the administrative settings and preferences for Settings Goldsettings.
steps: Navigate to the Settings panel.
Adjust the system preferences as needed.
Save the configuration to apply changes globally.

settings::settings-goldsettings::add_gol.purpose: Configure the administrative settings and preferences for Settings Goldsettings.
steps: Navigate to the Settings panel.
Adjust the system preferences as needed.
Save the configuration to apply changes globally.

settings::settings-propertyvaluation.purpose: Configure baseline property valuation rates per district, used to estimate current market value for Real Estate fixed assets.
steps: Navigate to Settings > Property Valuation Settings.
Scrape current district rates from Aqarmap, or load hardcoded baseline rates.
Review and adjust rates per district as needed.
Save the valuation settings to apply them across the application.

advanced-reports::company.purpose: Evaluate corporate payroll distributions, employer expense allocations, and company cost breakdowns.
steps: Navigate to Expenses & Reports -> Advanced Reports.
Select the Company tab.
Compare company-level expenses, active workforce compensation, and per diem totals.

fixed-assets::analytics.purpose: Perform deep analytics on the valuation, depreciation, and return on investment (ROI) of your fixed assets.
steps: Navigate to Fixed Assets -> Analytics.
Examine asset appreciation trends, category valuations, and historical performance charts.
Compare real estate, vehicle, and precious metal asset portfolio weights.

financial-advisor::goal-planning::add_go.purpose: Define and set up a new financial savings goal with target amounts and deadline tracking.
steps: Navigate to Financial Advisor -> Goal Planning.
Click the Add Goal button.
Specify the goal title, target amount, current contribution, and deadline date.
Save the goal to start tracking progress and automated recommendation insights.

budgets.purpose: Set spending limits per category and period, automate repeating income and expenses, and see alerts when a budget is close to or over its limit.
steps: Open Budgets from the Expenses Reports group in the sidebar.
Use Add Budget to set an amount, period, category and alert threshold in your base currency.
Use Add Recurring to schedule a repeating transaction; pause or resume it at any time. Past start dates are not back-filled unless you choose to.
Review the alerts shown when spending reaches the alert threshold or exceeds the budget.

budgets::add_budget.purpose: Create or edit a spending budget.
steps: Enter a name and the budget amount.
Choose the period and, optionally, an expense category.
Set the alert threshold percentage.
Save to start tracking spending against the budget.

budgets::add_recurring.purpose: Create or edit a recurring transaction (salary, rent, subscriptions).
steps: Enter the transaction details and amount.
Choose how often it repeats and the start date.
Save; due transactions are previewed before they are created, and can be paused or resumed.

import-data.purpose: Bring existing data into WealthFlow from a CSV or Excel file or a bank statement, with a preview before anything is saved.
steps: Open Import Data from the Expenses Reports group in the sidebar.
Choose the file and the type of data it contains.
Review the preview, including rows that will be skipped or rejected.
Confirm to import; nothing is saved until you confirm.

auth::privacy.purpose: Read how WealthFlow collects, uses and protects your personal data. This page is public and follows your chosen language. The text is a draft that needs legal review before public launch.
steps: Open Privacy Policy from the link under the sign-in or sign-up form, or from the sidebar footer.
Read the sections on the data collected, AI features, payments, cookies, retention and your rights.
Use the language selector to read it in English, Arabic, French or German.

auth::terms.purpose: Read the rules for using WealthFlow: accounts, acceptable use, plans and payments, AI answers and liability. This page is public and follows your chosen language. The text is a draft that needs legal review before public launch.
steps: Open Terms of Service from the link under the sign-in or sign-up form, or from the sidebar footer.
Read the sections on your account, acceptable use, plans and payments, and liability.
Use the language selector to read it in English, Arabic, French or German.

billing-plans.purpose: View your plan and trial status, and upgrade. When a free trial or subscription has ended, this is the only page available: the rest of the app is locked until you upgrade.
steps: Check the banner under the top bar: it shows the days left in your trial, or that your trial or subscription has ended.
Compare the available plans and choose Upgrade to request or start a paid plan.
After upgrading, access to every page is restored immediately; your data is kept while the account is locked.

Under the plans, the Your data card lets you Export my data (a JSON file with everything you own) or Delete my account: enter your password and type DELETE; this is permanent and also works while the account is locked.

settings::settings-billing.purpose: Set up online payments with Paymob and manage the billing plans and their prices. Gulf accounts (SAR / AED) are configured separately because each Paymob region has its own account.
steps: Open Settings, then More and Billing Plans (system administrators only).
Fill in the main Paymob account: API key, HMAC secret, integration ID and iframe ID. Until it is filled in, checkout runs in test mode and no real charge is made.
Optionally fill in a SAR and an AED account (Paymob host such as ksa.paymob.com, keys, integration and iframe). A currency without an account cannot be paid online once any account is live.
Choose which currencies the main account serves, then Save.
Add or edit plans and their prices in each currency.
